title: Opening of day two, January 14, 2011
summary: Brown re-opens the interview on the second day, asks about her cold, and invites additions to the previous day.

blocks.x: It’s great, though, because it’s not really an interview. It’s really you, just telling your story. It’s the flow. Today is January 14th, 2011. This is day two of the Smithsonian National Endowment for the Arts Jazz Oral History interview with Annie Ross, conducted by Anthony Brown and Ken Kimery in her home in New York City. Annie, how are you feeling today? A little under the weather with this cold, I believe.
I’ve got a cold, but you know, people say to me, “How can you sing with a cold?” You learn.
Famous words to live by, you vocalists. So Annie, maybe if there are any things you want to add to yesterday’s interview as far as the chronology or experiences?
